art_style: High-end 3D Chinese anime style (Donghua), Unreal Engine 5 render, similar to 'A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality' (凡人修仙传). Perfect realistic materials for fabrics and skin, extremely high polygon count, ray tracing.

lighting.default_quality: High-contrast cinematic lighting, heavy chiaroscuro, low-key lighting, UE5 Lumen lighting.
lighting.ambiance: Cold, tense, melancholic, often utilizing moonlight, realistic volumetric fog, firelight or dim oil lamps to create strong shadows with subsurface scattering on character skin.

color_palette.description: Desaturated, heavy on cool tones (blues, blacks, greys) for environments, contrasted with warm but dim light sources (orange/yellow flames).

texture: Ultra-realistic material textures (silk, rough linen, wood grain, wet stone), subtle film grain, depth of field effects, highly detailed 3D hair physics and rendering.
camera_lens: 35mm for environmental wide shots, 85mm for intimate/intense character close-ups. Deep depth of field for wide shots, shallow depth of field (bokeh) for character emotional focus.
